newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai audio, video tape producer sets IPO price.
newsitem.headline: Thai audio, video tape producer sets IPO price.

text.p: Thai audio and video tape producer ONPA International Plc set its initial public offer price for seven million new shares at 132 baht (US$5.28) each, the lead underwriter said on Friday.
The new shares will be opened for subscription from October 15 to October 17, an investment banker at Chao Phaya Finance and Securities told reporters.
Five million of the shares will be issued to foreign investors, while the remainder will be sold locally, he said.
Yamaichi Merchant Bank (Singapore) will be the lead underwriter for international offer, he said.

In the first six months of 1996, ONPA posted a total revenue of 1.2 billion baht and net profit 190 million baht. In 1995, the company had a revenue of 2.1 billion baht and net profit of 226 million baht.
